nodes.label: Logo v3 — Ornate Illustrated Badge on White Background (PNG)
nodes.description: PNG on a solid white background. Visually identical to Logo_v2.png in all design elements: ornate gold scrollwork circular badge, crimson red background, cream uppercase 'CHICKEN' and 'TIME' text, bronze clock face with crossed spatula/fork, chili pepper motifs and flames, richly illustrated cockerel mascot in teal/red/orange holding hot sauce bottle with chef's hat, brown leather-look ribbon banner reading 'Piri Piri & Perfection' with 'EST. 2024'. The only difference from v2 is the solid white background instead of transparent. Suitable for print contexts where transparency isn't supported.
